items.question: What physical and solitary condition characterizes the eight-year-old goddess as seen by the demon commander?
premises: The demon commander sees the girl.
She is alone on a chariot.
She is soft-limbed and eight years old.
items.inference: The verse portrays the goddess as a solitary, youthful, chariot-mounted figure before confrontation.
uncertainties: The verse supplies description rather than an explicit doctrinal claim; battle context comes from surrounding verses.
items.plain_english: Alone, mounted on a chariot, soft-limbed, and eight years old.
